proc bumpCommand(dir, versionArg, levelStr, depName: string): int {....raises: [
    IOError, IOError, IOError, IOError, Exception, IOError, KeyError,
    InvalidVersionError, ParseError, ValueError],
    tags: [WriteIOEffect, ReadDirEffect, ReadIOEffect, RootEffect], forbids: [].}
Bump the package.json found from dir upwards. versionArg sets an exact version, levelStr picks major|minor|patch (default patch), depName retargets a direct dependency instead of the own version. Returns the process exit code. 
proc bumpSpec(spec: string; level: BumpLevel): string {.
    ...raises: [BumpError, InvalidVersionError], tags: [], forbids: [].}
The spec at the next level, prefix preserved. */latest/git specs raise BumpError (nothing to move). 
proc bumpVersion(v: Version; level: BumpLevel): Version {.
    ...raises: [InvalidVersionError], tags: [], forbids: [].}
The next version at level (higher levels reset, metadata drops). 
proc findGroupSpan(content: string; group: string; glo, ghi: var int): bool {.
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Span of the "group": {...} object value (glo at {, ghi past }). False when the group is absent or not an object. 
proc findValueSpan(content: string; key, expected: string; depth, lo, hi: int;
                   valStart, valEnd: var int): bool {....raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
Raw inner span of "key": "expected" with key at object depth depth inside [lo, hi). Depth counts from the slice start, so top-level keys scan with depth = 1 over the whole file and dep keys with depth = 1 over their group span. 
proc isBumpableSpec(spec: string): bool {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
False for */latest/"" (no version inside) and for git, URL, npm:-alias-bare and local specs (no semver to move).

major|minor|patch (any case), else a BumpError.

The spec pointing at v, prefix preserved. * becomes exact; git/URL/local specs raise BumpError.

Leading range operator (^ ~ >= <= > < = v, blanks) off a dep spec: "^ 1.2.3" → ("^", "1.2.3"), "1.2.3" → ("", "1.2.3").
